race.description: Picklebet Get Your Pickle On Hcp (55)
race.comment: DON'T STOP ME NOW (13) finished a fair fourth in a slightly tougher field at Toowoomba 17 days ago, and dropping back to 1500m will suit her. A good draw will suit her, and she will have no fitness concerns fourth up from a spell. Each-way value. JOTOPELI (5) led up and faded at Eagle Farm nearly 3 weeks ago, and his third beforehand is the guide to use. He cops a wide gate but is well worth including in all top 4 combos. ZOUSAIN GIRL (10) had an excuse at Ipswich 11 days ago, she is probably better off over this shorter trip. Stick with her on an each-way basis. RAGING (3) was not too far away last start, and he is reunited with Harry Shaw who was aboard for his only win to date. In the mix. SOUTHOFTHEBORDER (8) is looking for some better ground, and with conditions to suit him, he can figure in the top 3 at some nice value.
